news.title: Jetmall Spices and Masala Limited to Report Second Half, 2026 Results on May 13, 2026
news.body: Jetmall Spices and Masala Limited announced that they will report second half, 2026 results on May 13, 2026

news.title: High number of new and inexperienced directors
news.body: There are 5 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: 5 new directors. No experienced directors. No highly experienced directors. Non-Executive Independent Director Harpreet Singh is the most experienced director on the board, commencing their role in 2025. The following issues are considered to be risks according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model: Lack of board continuity. Lack of experienced directors.

news.title: Jetmall Spices and Masala Limited Appoints Ms Puja Kalwar as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, Effective January 21, 2026
news.body: Jetmall Spices and Masala Limited approved the appointment of Ms. Puja Kalwar as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer of the company, designated as Key Managerial Personnel. Ms. Puja Kalwar is a qualified Company Secretary and a member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI). She possesses sound knowledge of corporate laws, secretarial practices, and regulatory compliance. She will be responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable statutory and regulatory requirements, as well as maintaining proper corporate governance practices. The appointment is effective January 21, 2026. The board meeting was held on January 21, 2026.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 6.9% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Earnings have declined by 15% per year over the past 5 years. Revenue is less than US$1m (₹5.5m revenue, or US$61k).
